import numpy as np

    andes.get_case("5bus/pjm5bus.json"),

    no_output=True,
)

    "selected_line_ids": [str(line_ids[i]) for i in rank_indices],
    "selected_line_metrics": [float(abs_a1[i]) for i in rank_indices],
}
